## Schema.table() method

Add to or drop from an existing table.

**Signature:**


## Remarks

Columns are added one `ALTER TABLE` at a time, sqlite's limit. Modifying an existing column's type or nullability is not supported; use [Schema.raw()](./database.schema.raw.md) for that.
